pr_title: Add type label for network interfaces
pr_body:
##### Summary
SSIA

Closes #13128

##### Test Plan
Check the `http://localhost:19999/api/v1/chart?chart=net.<interface name>` endpoint. `chart_labels` should contain `"type":"virtual"` or `"type":"real"`.

issue_context.title: [Feat]: add "type" label to proc.plugin/proc_net_dev charts
issue_context.body:
### Problem

Not possible to split proc_net_dev metrics for virtual and real (physical) interfaces.

### Description

Add "type" label to proc_net_dev charts. The value should be either "virtual" or "physical" (or "real").

> **Note** 
> Have a feeling that "type" is not the best label name, but can't find anything better - will discuss it before merging the implementation PR.

### Importance

really want

### Value proposition

1. Will allow to group "Network Interfaces" charts by type when using Cloud.


### Proposed implementation

_No response_
